Its range engine explicitly places `xsd:anyURI` in the undecided remainder (`crates/xsd/src/range.rs:40-48`). Any ontology behavior requiring native `anyURI` membership or facet reasoning may therefore remain undecided when delegated to PurRDF. [::Blackcat-Informatics/purrdf::] ### `Blackcat-Informatics/gmeow-gts` - GTS preserves explicit literal datatypes and defaults only literals without language/direction/datatype to `xsd:string` (`docs/GTS-SPEC.md §7.1`). The PR’s plain `logic:message` literals and explicit datatype-property restrictions are compatible with this transport contract. [::Blackcat-Informatics/gmeow-gts::] - The Rust and Go GTS validators accept `xsd:anyURI` lexical forms unchanged rather than applying URI-specific normalization (`rust/src/xsd.rs:114`, `go/xsd/xsd.go:106`). Any `anyURI` facet semantics must therefore be established by the ontology/reasoning layer before or after GTS transport, not by GTS itself. [::Blackcat-Informatics/gmeow-gts::]
